kelpie.name: The Kelpie
kelpie.realm: Ancient Rivers, Lochs, and Misty Waters
kelpie.title: The Wild Spirit of the Waters
kelpie.shortDescription: A mysterious and powerful spirit connected to untamed waters, transformation, and hidden depths.
kelpie.resultMessage: You are the Kelpie spirit. Like the legendary water beings of Scottish folklore, you are wild, adaptable, and impossible to forget. You carry a powerful presence and a deep connection to the mysteries hidden beneath the surface.

collectorCard.quote: The waters remember every secret whispered beneath the moon.
collectorCard.artPrompt: A majestic black water horse emerging from a mist-covered Scottish loch, glowing silver eyes, Celtic folklore atmosphere, moonlight reflecting on dark waters, fantasy watercolor style

banshee.name: The Banshee
banshee.realm: Ancient Hills, Sacred Lands, and Forgotten Places
banshee.title: The Whisperer Between Worlds
banshee.shortDescription: A spirit associated with intuition, memory, ancestral connection, and unseen truths.
banshee.resultMessage: You are the Banshee spirit. Like the ancient bean sí of Irish legend, you possess the gift of sensing what others miss. You are a keeper of memories, secrets, and stories that deserve to be remembered.

collectorCard.quote: Some voices are not warnings. Some are reminders of what we must never forget.
collectorCard.artPrompt: An ethereal Irish banshee spirit with flowing silver hair, standing among ancient ruins surrounded by mist, Celtic symbols glowing softly, haunting but beautiful fantasy watercolor style

pooka.name: The Pooka
pooka.realm: Hidden Forest Paths and Enchanted Crossroads
pooka.title: The Trickster of Endless Possibility
pooka.shortDescription: A shapeshifting spirit known for cleverness, curiosity, humor, and unexpected wisdom.
pooka.resultMessage: You are the Pooka spirit. Like the mysterious shapeshifters of Irish folklore, you bring laughter, imagination, and unexpected magic wherever you wander. Life is never ordinary when you are near.

collectorCard.quote: The greatest magic often begins with a little mischief.
collectorCard.artPrompt: A magical foxlike Pooka spirit standing in an enchanted Irish forest, glowing eyes, playful expression, Celtic runes, whimsical dark fantasy watercolor style

selkie.name: The Selkie
selkie.title: The Wanderer Between Worlds
selkie.shortDescription: A seal spirit connected to freedom, belonging, emotion, and the mysteries of the sea.
selkie.resultMessage: You are the Selkie spirit. Like the seal folk of coastal legends, you carry the magic of two worlds. Your heart seeks adventure, deep connections, and a place where you truly belong.

collectorCard.quote: The sea calls to those whose hearts remember where they came from.
collectorCard.artPrompt: A mystical selkie standing on a moonlit Scottish shore, silver ocean waves behind them, seal skin cloak nearby, Celtic fantasy watercolor style
